metadata.title: Patriotic Urban Portrait with Motion Blur

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring a central figure in a textured green mask against a blurred American flag background.
excludeWhen: natural lighting is preferred over flash

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a tattooed individual wearing a vibrant green knit balaclava and spiked neon green straps, set against a horizontally blurred American flag that creates a sense of kinetic energy.
coreVisualRelationships: The green mask acts as the primary focal point against the red and white stripes.
Motion blur in the background and foreground edges contrasts with the sharp detail of the mask.
Spiked vertical straps frame the torso and lead the eye toward the central jewelry.
coreInvariants: Vibrant green textured knit mask with visible eye and mouth openings
Symmetrical composition with a central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and occupies the middle two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright green knit mask serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the mask, moves down the spiked straps to the jewelry, and then outward to the blurred flag stripes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is filled with the subject and the flag pattern.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Red and white stripes of the flag provide the background structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant lime green of the mask and straps provides a sharp complementary contrast to the red.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver and gold from the jewelry and watch add metallic highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the greens and reds with deep shadows on the skin for a dramatic, high-value contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with tattoos wearing a bright green knit balaclava and neon green spiked straps. Place him in front of an American flag. Apply a heavy horizontal motion blur to the flag and the edges of the frame while keeping the mask sharp.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If text is needed, use a bold, distressed sans-serif font in white or neon green, placed at the bottom third of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the green mask the sharpest element?
Is the flag background visibly blurred horizontally?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos on the clothing or jewelry
Ensure the flag is a background element and not a literal flat graphic
postGenerationChecks: Verify horizontal blur effect on the flag
Ensure the mask texture is prominent
Confirm central symmetry of the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait = (Central Subject + High-Texture Accessory) * (High-Contrast Lighting) + (Symbolic Background with Motion Blur)
